info.title: Tonaris API
info.description: The /v1 contract shared by the web app, native clients and integrations. Changes within v1 are additive only.

get.summary: Check that the API is up

get.description: Albums MusicBrainz has for the title and artist, by the first artist and then by the title alone, each with its Cover Art Archive front, for the owner to choose from (FR-03.4). Albums without a front are left out. Choosing one is an ordinary artwork edit with its `artworkUrl`. 503 when MusicBrainz, or the archive for every album found, can't be asked.

get.description: The signed-in owner's whole collection as a ZIP (FR-08, TS-80): `tonaris-export.json` (format 1.0), `tonaris-export.schema.json`, `collection.md` and `README.md`, read in one consistent snapshot. Unsorted and Trash are included; sharing, Shared with me and the account's profile are not. Five exports an hour; over that, `429` with `Retry-After`.

Changes nothing.

The destination folder, or `root`. A move needs it; a recovery defaults to where it was, and an album's ignores it.

post.description: Runs up to 200 `BatchItem`s in order, each on its own, so a success stays whatever happens to later items (TS-25). An item runs only once every item it `dependsOn` is confirmed; otherwise it is `skipped`. Each item is validated and made idempotent by its `mutationId` as a single mutation is, so sending the batch again applies nothing twice. An `album.capture` item still running in another request answers the batch `409 in_progress`: the items before it stay saved, and sending the batch again replays them.
